Following today's "surprise launch" event, Apple has updated its official design resources website with new product bezel assets for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro. Details below.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro bezel assets now available

Designers should be no strangers to Apple's design resources website, which offers various hardware and software assets for use in their own work.

These assets cover Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG, and SVG files for Apple's various platforms, products, and technologies, and also include fonts, SF Symbols, Apple's Icon Composer, as well as logos and badges for services such as Apple Health and Apple Wallet.

After announcing the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro today, Apple has promptly updated the design resources website to provide Photoshop and PNG assets for these two new devices.

The assets include both folded and unfolded versions of the iPhone Duo in two colour options, as well as the iPhone 18 Pro model featuring a smaller Dynamic Island.

To view the new bezel assets and other existing materials on Apple's design resources website, please click here.
